site.name: Firefly Farm
site.subtitle: Nimbin, Northern Rivers NSW

rain.station: SILO gridded data at the property (BoM)

site.source: NSW LiDAR: Richmond River 2023 1 m bare-earth elevation model (NEMA / CSIRO, ELVIS); earlier survey Lismore July 2017 (NSW Spatial Services)
site.boundaryNote: Property outline from the NSW property register: the main block and the smaller house parcel to the west. The narrow reserve strip between them is included, as the owners treat it as part of the property (Blake, Oct 2026).
site.soilNote: Ground from the 2023 LiDAR at 1 m: tracks, benches, gullies and slips show under the forest. The 2017 comparison picks up real change (slips, creek banks, earthworks) plus scattered noise under dense forest.

catch.name: Everything that drains into Firefly Farm
